title: Reliability grade threshold sensitivity
inference: none; grades are recomputed from the stored analysis/metrics stores of the Phase 0 baseline runs

secondary_metrics.rule: Computed only after the margin_drop results are final, with the same settings; appendix only.

grade_rule.rule: sign_consistent FALSE -> unreliable; sign_consistent TRUE and exceeds_control, multi_strategy, ci_excludes_zero all TRUE -> high; sign_consistent TRUE, at least one of the three TRUE and none FALSE -> moderate; otherwise low

unavailable.sign_consistent, multi_strategy: no fill-strategy row for the anchor
unavailable.exceeds_control: no condition with control_available TRUE, n_controls >= 2, and effective std != 0
unavailable.ci_excludes_zero: no interval row for the anchor's region_key

z_threshold.definition: exceeds_control = max over evaluable conditions of z_c > tau_z

sign_alpha.definition: epsilon = alpha * S_run; an operator value v has sign +1 if v > epsilon, -1 if v < -epsilon, else 0. Only the sign function changes; sign_consistent and multi_strategy keep the v1.0.0 rules, so (+,+,0) is inconsistent and (0,0,0) is consistent.
sign_alpha.scale: S_run = median of |v| over every target (anchor, operator) value in strategy_stability for the run and metric (zeros included)

min_multi_strategy.definition: multi_strategy = count of the most common operator sign >= m

ci_level.method: ssat.analysis.interval percentile bootstrap over per-sample region means, n_bootstrap 1000, random_seed 0
ci_level.rng_stream: One generator seeded 0 is consumed across (region_key, metric) pairs in sorted order over every metric in the stored analysis, exactly as compute_intervals does; one set of resample means per region is used for all four levels.

ddof.definition: std_d = control_std0 * sqrt(n / (n - d)), n = n_controls of the condition

std_floor_beta.definition: std_eff = max(std_d, beta * B_run); z_c = excess_c / std_eff for n_controls >= 2 and std_eff != 0
std_floor_beta.scale: B_run = median of control_std (ddof 0) over control_comparison rows of the run and metric with control_available TRUE and n_controls >= 2 (zeros included)

applicability.ntu60: No matched controls, so exceeds_control is UNAVAILABLE and tau_z, d, beta are not applicable; only alpha, m, and CI level are swept, and presets apply only their alpha/m/CI components.
applicability.scales: S_run and B_run are computed once per run and metric from the default feature table and do not depend on the swept setting.

seed_cv_threshold.report: seed_stable TRUE/FALSE/UNAVAILABLE rates only; the flag does not enter the grade

area_match_tolerance.report: share of control/target effective-area ratios within tolerance, reported by B1 (control_area_ratio.csv); the flag does not enter the grade

parity_gate.unit_test: tests/unit/test_rev1_grade_engine.py compares grade_anchors(default) with the ssat analyze output on small dumps, including the UNAVAILABLE paths (no control, zero control std, one control, no strategy row).
parity_gate.real_runs: run_sweep.py --check-parity: for every run, the default-setting flags (sign_consistent, exceeds_control, multi_strategy, ci_excludes_zero) and grade must equal reliability.parquet with zero mismatches, and the recomputed 95% intervals must match intervals.parquet (excludes_zero and point_estimate exactly, bounds within 1e-12). The sweep does not run otherwise.

figures.fig_a1_z_curve.pdf: grade share vs tau_z curve; panels synthetic_shortcut, synthetic_normal, and the four ImageNet runs; vertical line at 2.0; max_z histogram inset
figures.fig_a1_oat.pdf: agreement and >=2-grade change per parameter value (tornado form), one panel per dataset
figures.fig_a1_transitions.pdf: default->lenient and default->conservative transition heatmaps for imagenet_mnv2_050_exact_k3 and synthetic_shortcut

summaries.agreement: Per run and setting, against the default setting on the same anchors: agreement, linear weighted kappa over the ordinal grade order unreliable < low < moderate < high, unchanged / 1-step / >=2-step shares, up / down shares.

boundary_mass.definition: share of anchors with an evaluable max_z in [tau - delta, tau + delta] at tau = 2.0

summaries.sensitivity_ranking: Per run, each parameter's maximum disagreement (1 - agreement) over its registered OAT values; parameters ranked by that value.
summaries.by_cell: For the 4x4 grid runs (ImageNet, synthetic), agreement and HIGH share per cell and per cell type (corner r0c0,r0c3,r3c0,r3c3; center r1c1,r1c2,r2c1,r2c2; edge the other eight), for the OAT settings and presets.
summaries.synthetic_gt: Over the tau_z curve, the alpha OAT values, and the presets: HIGH share of the patch anchors (cell r0/c0) and of the other 15 cells in synthetic_shortcut, and the same two shares in synthetic_normal. Descriptive only; no threshold is chosen from it.

optional_analyses.zero_abstain: Implementation plan section 3.7: with alpha > 0, zero signs abstain (sign_consistent TRUE if the non-zero signs agree and at least one exists, UNAVAILABLE if all are zero; multi_strategy counts the dominant non-zero sign). Reported as a design alternative only.

representative_cases: none; A1 reports aggregate tables and figures only
subsets: none; every anchor of every run is used
